notYou: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.

confirmation.heading: Confirm your email address
confirmation.body: Thanks for joining {{productName}}. Press the button to confirm your email address. Until you do, you can read stories but you can’t publish, comment, post or send messages.
confirmation.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.

magicLink.heading: Your log-in link
magicLink.body: Press the button to log in to {{productName}}. No password needed.
magicLink.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.

recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your {{productName}} account. If it was you, press the button to choose a new one.
recovery.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.

passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your {{productName}} account has just been changed, and we logged you out on every other device. If this wasn’t you, reset your password now.
passwordChanged.linkNote: You can see where you’re logged in under Settings.

emailChange.heading: Your code to change your email address
emailChange.body: Someone asked to change the email address of a {{productName}} account. We send one code to the current address and another to the new one. Type both in Settings, and the change happens only once both are right. Until then, the current address keeps working.
emailChange.linkNote: The code works once and expires after an hour.
